storeHeld: Held in the {store} store, so it survives a restart
storeAtomic: , and recording a use is one atomic claim in that database, so every process against it agrees at once.
storeNotAtomic: . That store does not coordinate processes, and a service that dispatches refuses to start without one that does.
searchNewest: A search of the newest rows
leadEvery: Every RFC 7523 JWT and RFC 7522 SAML assertion this realm has accepted — to authenticate a client (client_assertion) or as an authorization grant (assertion) — and that has not yet expired. An assertion is accepted once, ever: this is ONE history for both uses and both profiles, keyed by the document's format, its issuer and its jti or ID, so a JWT that authenticated a client cannot then be spent as a grant. The assertion itself is never stored.
leadInFlight: In flight is an assertion that was accepted on a token request whose response has not finished; a replay racing it is refused exactly as on a spent one. It becomes spent only when that response is a 2xx — tokens were issued — and a request that failed for another reason (a bad code, an invalid scope, the issuance gate) RELEASES it, because an assertion that bought nothing has not been used.
leadKept: A row is kept until the assertion would have expired — its exp or NotOnOrAfter plus the clock skew allowed when it was read — and not a moment longer. When oauth2.assertionReplayCacheSize unexpired rows are held, the next assertion is REFUSED rather than a live row forgotten.
placeholder: an issuer, a jti, a client
empty: No assertion has been accepted in this realm, or every one has expired.
footer: This list is GET /admin-api/used-assertions with the same parameters. Paging is ?page= and ?per= (at most {max} rows a page).
